summary: Tested SC RM Resolution Bug Fix for Manufacturing ERP. The fix correctly resolves SC lines: completed parts (PT-1) appear as themselves, uncompleted parts (PT-2) are resolved to their constituent raw materials. E2E test verified the full workflow: FG→SG→PT-1+PT-2, complete PT-1's MO, create SC for SG - SC lines correctly show PT-1 (qty 4) + RM-TEST-1 (qty 4) + RM-TEST-2 (qty 6). SC recalculation on second create-sc call also works correctly.
